description: Source-of-truth catalog of consumer-relevant MCP tools. Read by the stdio server (scripts/mcp_server/) and packed into the Cloud Worker bundle (workers/mcp/). Phase 1 of road-to-mcp-full-coverage: tools without 'implemented' transports return the 'not_implemented' envelope defined in docs/contracts/mcp-tool-stub-envelope.md. The 'implemented_on' field lists transports where the real handler is wired; everything else is a discovery stub. See agents/roadmaps/archive/road-to-mcp-full-coverage.md.

tools.name: lint_skills
tools.description: Lint skill / rule / command / guideline / persona markdown files. Returns the same JSON payload as `scripts/skill_linter.py --format json`. Read-only — never writes or spawns git. Pass `paths` to lint a subset, omit for a full tree scan.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths to lint. Empty / missing → full tree scan.

tools.name: chat_history_append
tools.description: Append one entry to the consumer's chat-history JSONL (`agents/.agent-chat-history`). Path-scoped — writes outside the allowlist raise ValueError. Use `dry_run` to preview the payload without touching the filesystem.

entry_type.description: Short `t` tag (e.g. note, decision). Defaults to `note`.

path.description: Optional path override. Must resolve to `agents/.agent-chat-history` or `.agent-chat-history` under consumer_root.

tools.name: chat_history_read
tools.description: Read recent chat-history entries from `agents/.agent-chat-history`. Filter by session, limit, or entry-type. Read-only.

last.description: Return only the last N entries.

tools.name: memory_lookup
tools.description: Hybrid memory retrieval over `agents/memory/<type>/*.yml` and `agents/memory/intake/*.jsonl`. Read-only.

types.description: Memory types to scan (e.g. ownership, historical-patterns).

tools.name: memory_signal
tools.description: Append an engineering-memory signal to `agents/memory/intake/signals-YYYY-MM.jsonl`. Rate-limited per `(type, path)` within a rolling window.

path.description: Anchor path the signal is about.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: Report whether the optional `@event4u/agent-memory` package is reachable, and surface its routing metadata. Read-only.

tools.name: skill_trigger_eval
tools.description: Score a user message against the compiled router and return the matching skills with their trigger reasons. Read-only.

tools.name: suggest_command
tools.description: Run the command-suggestion engine: score commands against a user message + context and return the numbered options block. Read-only, deterministic.

tools.name: suggest_skill_for_task
tools.description: Match a free-form task description to the most relevant skills with frontmatter triggers. Read-only.

tools.name: mine_session
tools.description: Extract patterns, decisions, and learnings from a chat-history session JSONL. Read-only.

path.description: Optional path to a chat-history JSONL.

tools.name: update_form_request_messages
tools.description: Sync the `messages()` method of a Laravel FormRequest class — add missing entries, link to language keys, drop stale ones.

request_class.description: Fully-qualified FormRequest class FQN or repo-relative file path.

tools.name: sync_gitignore
tools.description: Synchronise the `event4u/agent-config` block in the consumer project's `.gitignore` — adds missing entries, preserves user-added lines.

tools.name: sync_agent_settings
tools.description: Synchronise `.agent-settings.yml` against the current template + profile — adds new sections/keys, preserves user values.

profile.description: Override the profile pinned in the settings file.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Execute the consumer project's test suite via the project's standard test runner. Returns the exit code, runner name, and a structured tail of the output.

filter.description: Restrict to tests matching this pattern.

path.description: Restrict to tests under this directory.

tools.name: run_quality_checks
tools.description: Run the configured quality gate (PHPStan / Rector / ECS / equivalent) and return a structured per-tool result.

tool.description: Restrict to a single tool name.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Enumerate every skill currently exposed as a prompt, with name + description + source. Read-only manifest view.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Enumerate every slash command currently exposed as a prompt. Read-only manifest view.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Enumerate every rule currently exposed as a resource. Read-only manifest view.

tools.name: compile_router
tools.description: Regenerate the compiled router (`router.compiled.json`) from the current rule / skill / command frontmatter. Shell-bound — wraps `scripts/compile_router.py`.

tools.name: read_resource_body
tools.description: Fetch the rendered body of any resource URI (rule, guideline, context) without going through `resources/read`. Convenience for clients that want to inline content into a tool call result.
